# axm mcps install

Reinstall configured MCP servers from their sources, or install an MCP server from a registry

## When to use

Reinstall configured MCP servers from their sources, or install an MCP server from a registry

## Usage

```bash
axm mcps install [flags] [<source>]
```

## Arguments

| Name     | Type   | Required | Description                                                   |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source` | string | No       | Registry MCP server reference (@owner/mcps/name or bare name) |

## Flags

| Name                | Type    | Required | Description                                                                       |
| ------------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`           | choice  | No       | Install to project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--yes`, `-y`       | boolean | No       | Skip confirmation after reviewing the install plan                                |
| `--force`, `-f`     | boolean | No       | Reinstall even if the MCP server already exists                                   |
| `--preview`         | boolean | No       | Show what would be installed without making changes                               |
| `--env`, `-e`       | string  | No       | Provide an MCP input value as KEY=VALUE                                           |
| `--non-interactive` | boolean | No       | Use defaults and placeholders instead of prompting for MCP inputs                 |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Reinstall all configured MCP servers from their sources**

```bash
axm mcps install
```

**Add an MCP server from the registry**

```bash
axm mcps install @acme/mcps/my-server
```

**Install using your default owner**

```bash
axm mcps install my-server
```

**See what would be installed first**

```bash
axm mcps install @acme/mcps/my-server --preview
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
